summary: Chilwa Minerals filed a 6-K attaching two press releases announcing the pricing and closing of a US$3.5 million underwritten US IPO/ADS offering alongside a new Nasdaq Capital Market listing under ticker CHWM; ordinary shares continue trading on the ASX as CHW. The deal comprised 625,000 ADSs (each equal to 10 ordinary shares) plus 625,000 warrants at US$5.60 per ADS and accompanying warrant, with a 45-day underwriter option for 92,000 additional ADSs/warrants. Maxim Group LLC served as sole book-running manager. Proceeds fund exploration and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising/listing event, not a special situation; watch post-IPO ADS trading and warrant overhang.
